onboarding_welcome_tagline: Private, encrypted calendar with multiple color-coded calendars, online calendar subscriptions, ICS import/export, and voice-created events.
onboarding_bullet1_desc: Say "dentist in a week" and Vox Commander creates the event, picking the right calendar for you.
onboarding_bullet2_desc: Multiple color-coded calendars like Personal or Work, subscribe to an online calendar, or import an ICS file as its own new one.
onboarding_bullet3_desc: Your calendar never leaves your phone unless you export it yourself.
onboarding_permissions_intro: Grant this so Vox Calendar can confirm things happened, even when it's running in the background. You can change it later in your device Settings.
permission_notif_desc: Needed so a confirmation can show when a voice/LLM-created event is added in the background.
set_as_main_subscribed_note: A subscribed calendar can't be the main one.
subscribe_calendar_url_invalid: Must start with https://, http://, or webcal://
delete_layer_confirm_desc: You can delete every event and to-do list in this calendar, or move them all to the Main calendar instead.
ics_settings_desc: Import or export your calendar as a standard .ics file, for interop with Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Thunderbird, and others. Separate from Vox Hub's own backup, which uses a different format.
entry_subscribed_read_only_note: This entry is from a subscribed online calendar, so it's view-only — you can still set a reminder for it below.
reminder_recurring_next_occurrence_note: For a repeating entry, reminders are scheduled against the next upcoming occurrence.
reminder_set_by_calendar_note: Set by this calendar's reminder settings.
calendar_reminders_desc: When set, every entry in this calendar uses these reminders instead of its own.
reminder_exact_alarm_permission_needed: Precise reminder timing requires a permission this device hasn't granted yet.
delete_entry_message: This event or task will be permanently deleted.
cleanup_confirm_message: The following field(s) contain only symbols or the text "null":
entry_time_error: End time must be after start time
require_fingerprint_desc: Lock the app behind a biometric or device credential prompt
debug_logging_desc: Verbose logs for troubleshooting — off by default
commander_required_message: This feature requires Vox Commander to be installed and configured
vision_required_message: This feature requires Vox Vision to be installed
attach_photo_on_scan: Process photo with AI on scan
attach_photo_on_scan_desc: Send the scanned photo to the AI alongside the recognized text (needs Vision's "send photo to AI" setting on too, and a multimodal engine configured)
delete_attachment_group_message: Every photo in this group will be removed.
widget_show_event_details_desc: Show each event's description under its title in the home-screen widget. Turn off for a more compact list.
widget_border_enabled_desc: Draw an outline around each day's group of records in the home-screen widget.
notifications_system_default_desc: Use Android system settings for reminders and alerts
notifications_sound_desc: Play a sound when a notification arrives
todo_delete_list_message: All items in this list will be permanently deleted.
todo_list_empty: No items yet — tap to add some.
todo_lists_empty: No to-do lists yet — tap + to create one.
todo_bleed_to_calendar_desc: Whether to-do items with a due date/time also show up on the standard Month/Week/Day/Year grid. Reminders keep working either way.
animations_enabled_desc: Decorative transition animations, like the flip between Calendar and To-do lists.
locked_message: The calendar is locked. Unlock the app.
field_correction_memory_desc: When you fix a garbled word while editing an entry, remember the fix and apply it to future captures
todo_widget_list_missing: This list no longer exists. Remove the widget and add it again.
todo_routine_hint: Unchecks at midnight on the chosen days
todo_delete_item_message: The item and its attachments are removed from the list.
delete_attachment_message: The photo is removed from this record.
backup_import_mode_desc: How restoring a file reconciles it against what's already here. Only applies when Data is on.
backup_import_mode_caveat_merge: Safest: restores the file and deletes only records that existed when it was exported — anything created here afterwards is kept.
backup_import_mode_caveat_full_override: DELETES everything — including records created AFTER the backup — then restores only what the file contains.
backup_import_mode_caveat_additive: Never deletes anything — restoring the same file again DUPLICATES its records.
